title: 第11章 娘快来看这块玉佩！

content_zh:
这卢俊辉就没有想到，他不过是一个没落三等伯府的长公子而已，只有个秀才的身份，爹爹不过是正五品的京官，凭什么让一等靖安侯府正二品大员唯一的继承人嫁给他做妾？
不知道是不是自己骗自己，还是将慧姐真当成了大夫人那个失去双亲寄住在仁安伯府的何沛玲表姑娘了！
卢俊辉收回了自己的思绪，听着母亲又训了几句，良好的认错，这让那些丫鬟更加的恨了叶表姑娘了，害的她们心中的男神这般没有脸面的被训斥。
看着哥哥挨训，旁边的卢代蓉不高兴的道：“娘，你瞪着哥哥说他做什么？是叶沁慧自己晚上不睡觉，玩什么随风椅，差点出了性命，难道是哥哥让她去的不成，昨个闹了一夜，今个还不醒，我们巴巴的过来看她，架子大起来了，也不知道等着谁去安慰呢，哼，脸皮厚！”
十五岁的长房嫡次女一张嘴就没有好话，大夫人呵斥道：“蓉姐胡说什么？”
卢代蓉还想说什么，可是一看母亲一脸的威严，想想此时的情况，也想起刚临来是母亲的吩咐，嘴巴蠕动几下，最终还是没张口。
这会子王妈妈狗腿的出来道：“哎呦，大夫人真真是菩萨心肠，我们姑娘昨夜出事之后，又是看大夫，又是请太医，又是让人熬药的，不知道的就是亲娘也不过如此啊，大夫人这冬天的日头虽然不毒，但是冷的慌，还是进来吧。”
王妈妈在看大夫人的同时，别有用意的看了一眼跟在大夫人跟前的大少爷卢俊辉，果然是一表人才的翩翩俊公子，不知道想起了什么，嘴巴不停的说着好话。
这王妈妈是真的挺败类的，她这会子几车的好话说出去，不知道还真的以为大夫人多好，多么菩萨心肠呢？
殊不知那个杜太医是慧姐三婶杜氏娘家的叔叔，是慧姐最贴心的丫鬟秀雁传信给自家哥哥请来的，而杜太医受到叶大人所托，本来已经休息了，结果一听这么严重的事情，赶快就赶了过来，否则慧姐性命堪忧。
大夫人就这样被迎进了清花阁慧姐的里屋内室，男女有别卢俊辉就在外间的椅子上坐下，还一脸担忧的看着内室的门，好似能将这份焦急传递进去一般。
秀雁冷眼看着大夫人简单的行个礼，就站在床边，深怕这些人在起了什么不好的心思。
大夫人坐在床前，看着因为失血过多脸色苍白的慧姐，捏着帕子哭道：“慧姐我可怜的孩子啊，看你这样真真是剜了大舅母的心啊……”
大夫人范郁琴还真是唱做俱佳了，已经四十岁的人了，这剜心的戏码演了将近两刻钟，最后还有要昏厥的架势，急的屋子里三个大丫头纷纷过来，屋子里乱成一团，这么一闹半个时辰都过去了。
躺在床上的贝儿只感觉异常的吵闹，不知道哪个欧巴桑哭的跟没了爹娘似的，难道是哭自己呢？
可是贝儿感觉真要是哭自己呢，这么唱做俱佳的至于吗，真正关心你的人不需要如此，那么只有一个结果就是演戏的来了。
随后贝儿似乎看见了一抹浓烈喜人的翠绿色包裹了自己的身子，这热度降下来不少，刚才头痛欲裂疼那种要命的感觉也减低了不少，思路也渐渐的清晰起来，跟这个相比，这样恼人的声音就自动忽略了。
“慧姐啊，舅母真是对不住你啊，没管好你的表哥，非要给你弄什么随风椅，这真要出了事情，怎么和叶家交代啊，都是舅母不好啊……”
大夫人还不停的说着类似的话，秀雁感觉这大夫人不过是来推卸责任的，根本不是过来看姑娘的，这不是大夫人说这说着又要晕过去了，这还有完没完了。
秀雁瞧见到外面站着的都是二等以下的奴婢，屋子里这乱糟糟的，要是影响姑娘养病就不好了。

秀雁走到门边，正好看见外间等候大夫人的俊辉表少爷，听见大夫人几次昏厥动静也不敢乱闯，急的在外间来回的踱步。
内室还在演劝大夫人回去休息的戏码，故此秀雁几步走过来道：“凌嬷嬷我们姑娘这里暂且没事，凌嬷嬷还是让大夫人回去休养吧，省着我们姑娘醒了会怪罪奴婢没照顾好大夫人的。”

content_en:
Lu Junhui never thought that he was just the eldest son of a third-class uncle who had declined. He only had the status of a scholar. His father was only a fifth-rank official in the capital. Why would he let the only heir to a second-rank official of the first-class Jing'an Marquis Palace marry him as a concubine?
I don’t know if I am lying to myself, or if I really think that Sister Hui is the cousin of the eldest lady, He Peiling, who lost her parents and lives in Ren'anbo Mansion!
Lu Junhui withdrew his thoughts and listened to his mother's reprimands and acknowledgment of his mistakes. This made the maids hate Miss Ye Biao even more, causing the male god in their hearts to be reprimanded in such a shameless manner.
Seeing her brother being scolded, Lu Dairong next to her said unhappily: "Mom, what are you glaring at my brother and saying? It was Ye Qinhui who didn't sleep at night, playing with the wind chair, and almost died. Could it be that her brother asked her to go. She was in trouble last night, and she is still awake today. We came over to see her. She has become more arrogant, and we don't know who is waiting to comfort her. Huh, shameless!"
The fifteen-year-old eldest daughter-in-law had no good words to say. The eldest lady scolded: "Sister Rong, what are you talking nonsense about?"
Lu Dairong wanted to say something else, but when he saw the majesty on his mother's face, thinking about the situation at this time, and remembering that it was his mother's order just now, his mouth squirmed a few times, but in the end he did not open his mouth.
At this moment, Mrs. Wang came out and said: "Oh, madam, you are really kind-hearted. After our girl had an accident last night, we went to see a doctor, hired an imperial doctor, and had people make medicine. What we don't know is that even my own mother is not like this. Although the sun in this winter is not poisonous, madam, it is very cold, so we might as well come in."
While Mrs. Wang was looking at the eldest lady, she glanced at the eldest young master Lu Junhui with ulterior motives. He was indeed a handsome young man with outstanding talent. She didn't know what she was thinking of, and kept saying nice things.
This Mrs. Wang is really a scumbag. After all the good things she said right now, I wonder if she really thinks that the eldest lady is so kind and has such a bodhisattva-like heart?
Little did they know that Doctor Du was the uncle of Sister Hui's third aunt, Du's family. Sister Hui's most considerate maid Xiu Yan sent a message to her brother to invite him. Doctor Du was entrusted by Lord Ye and had already rested. When he heard about such a serious matter, he rushed over quickly, otherwise Sister Hui's life would be in danger.
The eldest lady was welcomed into Sister Hui's inner room in Qinghua Pavilion. Lu Junhui sat down on a chair in the outer room. He looked at the door of the inner room with a worried look, as if he could convey his anxiety.
Xiuyan watched coldly as the eldest lady bowed briefly and stood by the bed, fearing that these people had some bad intentions.
The eldest lady was sitting in front of the bed, looking at Sister Hui who was pale due to excessive blood loss, holding the handkerchief and crying: "Sister Hui, my poor child, seeing you like this really breaks my aunt's heart..."
The eldest lady Fan Yuqin was really good at singing and acting. She was already forty years old. This heart-cutting scene lasted for nearly two quarters of an hour. At the end, she was about to faint. The three big girls in the room came over in a hurry. The room became a mess. Half an hour passed in this commotion.
Belle, who was lying on the bed, felt unusually noisy. Who knew which Obasan was crying as if he had lost his parents? Could it be that he was crying for himself?
But Belle feels that if she really cries for herself, what if she is so good at singing and acting? People who really care about you don't need to be like this. Then there is only one result: acting.
Then Belle seemed to see a strong and pleasant emerald green covering her body. The heat dropped a lot, and the terrible feeling of a splitting headache just now was also reduced a lot. Her thoughts gradually became clearer. Compared with this, such annoying sounds were automatically ignored.
"Sister Hui, my aunt is really sorry for you. She didn't take care of your cousin and insisted on getting you some kind of casual chair. Something is really going to happen.Qing, how should I explain it to the Ye family? It’s all my aunt’s fault..."
The eldest lady kept saying similar words. Xiuyan felt that the eldest lady was just here to shirk responsibility, and was not here to see the girl at all. This was not because the eldest lady was about to faint again after saying this. This was not over.
Xiuyan saw that all the slaves standing outside were second-class and below. The mess in the house would be bad if it affected the girl's recovery.
Xiuyan walked to the door and happened to see Young Master Junhui waiting for the eldest lady outside. Hearing the eldest lady fainting several times, he did not dare to rush in and paced back and forth anxiously outside.
The drama of persuading the eldest lady to go back to rest was still going on in the inner room, so Xiuyan walked over in a few steps and said: "Aunt Ling, our girl is fine here for the time being. Aunt Ling should let the eldest lady go back to rest, so that when our girl wakes up, she will blame the servant for not taking good care of the eldest lady. "
